# GitHub Copilot / Coding Agent Instructions

Follow the repository-wide instructions in `AGENTS.md`.

Before making changes:

1. Read `AI_LOGS/HANDOFF.md`.
2. Read `AI_LOGS/TASKS.md`.
3. Read `AI_LOGS/DECISIONS.md` when architecture or product decisions matter.

Before ending a meaningful session:

1. Update `AI_LOGS/HANDOFF.md`.
2. Update `AI_LOGS/TASKS.md`.
3. Add a session log under `AI_LOGS/SESSIONS/`.
